quests.title: A two-cell corridor
quests.ask: Fill a corridor of two cells: one gem on each, no more.
quests.nudge: Count the gems you need and the steps you take. Are they the same number?

quests.title: A one-cell corridor
quests.ask: The shortest corridor of all: one cell, with a wall straight ahead. It should end with exactly one gem.
quests.nudge: Which lines still run when the robot can't take a single step?
